**In older generations:** Yes, [Steel] type resists both Ghost and Dark attacks. According to the first result, Steel resists "Normal, Flying, Rock, Bug, Steel, Grass, Psychic, Ice, Dragon, Ghost, Dark."

So the answer depends on which game generation you're playing!
